title: Three Nights and One Short Ruler
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：inch　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 inch 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the observer ① marked the inch that no resident in the valley would have described, and he said the marking was the whole of the night. The ② inch, meaning the snow itself and not the ruler, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a inch, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ inch in that valley had the same short ruler beside it, and the ④ inch at the far roof, meaning the depth they kept for the children to measure and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A inch, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the observer said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the inch was the whole of the matter, meaning the distance and not the snow. The ⑥ inch, meaning the distance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; inch, he said, is either something you mark or the only word that means both a snow and a distance. He said the distance is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ inch had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short ruler. The ⑧ inch of the whole thing, the observer wrote in January, was one valley and three nights of describing; inch, he said, is either the depth at the far roof or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ inch I remember is the snow described in the log, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ inch, my mother said in 1980, is the only inch that improves by being described; every inch, she said, is a distance that has agreed to look like a snow. She said the distance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 英寸；少许（指山谷里每一寸旁边的那一寸）
B. n. 英寸；少许（指那寸积雪本身，与标尺相对）
C. 固定搭配：mark the inch 标出这一英寸
D. n. 英寸；少许（指留给孩子们量的那一点那一寸）
E. n. 尺寸之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的英寸之事）
F. n. 英寸；少许（指记录里写到、被记下的的那一寸）
G. n. 距离、分寸（指一件事里人人都量却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分寸（抽象总称，指人人都量却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: marked the inch that no resident in the valley would have described
The inch, meaning the snow itself and not the ruler
the inch at the far roof
the inch was the whole of the matter
the inch had become a line in a log
The inch of the whole thing
A inch, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: mark the inch 意为“标出这一英寸”，1971 年那位观测员把山谷里没有一位居民肯描述的一英寸做了一遍。
inch 意为“英寸；少许”，指那寸积雪本身而不是标尺，它经过了三个夜而在簿子上没有被描述。
inch 意为“英寸；少许”，指山谷里每一寸旁边的那一寸，每一寸旁边都有同一把小小的标尺。
inch 意为“英寸；少许”，指最远那片屋顶留给孩子们量的那一点那一寸，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
inch 意为“距离、分寸”，指一件事里人人都量却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段距离就是那件事的全部。
inch 意为“分寸”，指人人都量却无人提起的那样东西而不是那寸积雪，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
inch 意为“英寸；少许”，指记录里写到、被记下的的那一寸，到 1976 年这一寸成了记录里的一行。
inch 意为“尺寸之事”，观测员一月写道，整件事的英寸之事是一处山谷和三个夜的描述。
inch 意为“英寸；少许”，我记得的是记录里描述过的那一寸，1978 年量准了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一寸。
inch 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，英寸是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的积雪。
